source.title: Freedom of Information Act and Environmental Information Regulations
source.locator: How do I request information; validity and response route

rights.terms: Official public NHS England request guidance; no request or personal information is stored in this receipt.
rights.permitted_destination: request-routing metadata, citation, and unsent request preparation

disposition.rationale: Identifies the official written FOI route and the requirement for a real requester name, correspondence address, and specific description of recorded information.
disposition.contingency: Keep the request unsent until the requester identity/address and sending account are explicitly selected.
disposition.refresh_or_retry_condition: Refresh immediately before submission or if NHS England changes its contact route or validity requirements.
